en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to us by Ali b. al-Hussain al-Sa’dabadi from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from Ali b. al-Hussain al-Sayrafi from Hamad b. Isa from Ja’far from his father (a.s.) who said: “
I like keeping the Holy Quran at home. Allah keeps Satan away from the house because of it.”
